name: chi2pdf
expr: p_basic = chi2pdf(2, 3); p_zero_k2 = chi2pdf(0, 2); p_vec = chi2pdf(xv, 3); p_neg = chi2pdf(xneg, 3); p_k1 = chi2pdf(2, 1); p_k30 = chi2pdf(30, 30); p_kbad = chi2pdf(2, 0); p_kneg = chi2pdf(2, -1);
comment: Sig: y = chi2pdf(x, k). Chi-squared PDF with k dof. x < 0 => 0; k <= 0 => NaN. Covers: scalar, vector x, x<0 + x=0 edges, k=1 (special: x^(-1/2)·exp(-x/2)/√(2π)), k=30 large dof.
